CustomField.description: The default Campaign.Name for this template. Supports two placeholder tokens that the setup flow expands at load time: {yearLabel} (e.g. FY26 or CY26) and {yearShort} (e.g. 26). Expansion is done in Apex before campaign insert.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Template placeholders {yearLabel} and {yearShort} are replaced with the detected fiscal or calendar year before the Campaign is created. Example: Spring Appeal {yearLabel} becomes Spring Appeal FY26.
CustomField.label: Suggested Name
